## Windows x64 portable preview

Download **LanguageLens-0.1.2-windows-x64-preview.zip** (about 204 MiB), extract the complete folder, and open **LanguageLens.exe**. Keep the supporting files beside it. No Python, Git, or administrator access is required.

Choose **Text language** and **Translate into**, then use **Download required files** once. Optional voices are separate downloads. Capture, translation, and speech then run locally; no cloud API key is needed.

### Use it

Click **Start listening**, switch to another app, press **F8**, and drag around text. Hover over words for suggestions and read the whole-selection translation for context. Press **Escape** to return.

Lens does not pause other apps. Pause games manually before capturing; ordinary desktop and borderless-windowed apps are most dependable.

### Update and remove

Quit Lens from the tray, then extract the new ZIP into a complete new folder. Per-user settings, models, and voices are retained. Do not mix files from different releases.

To uninstall, quit Lens and open **LanguageLensUninstall.exe**. Shared Argos translation models have a separate cleanup confirmation.

### Status and limits

This is an unsigned portable preview. Clean-machine Windows validation remains pending. Recognition, translation, and pronunciation can be imperfect; exclusive fullscreen or protected video can produce black captures. Downloaded models and voices require additional space.
